    Performed a thorough exploration of the entire codebase across 5 turns. The application is a desktop Electron app ("Hangup Portal") built with Electron + Express.js + Supabase. I read the package.json, all route files, key lib files, all relevant migration files, and all frontend JS modules. The architecture is: Electron shell → Express HTTP server (app.js) → routes/api.js (main router) + routes/hrms.js → lib/* (business logic repos) → Supabase Postgres backend. Frontend is vanilla JS with no framework, served as static files from public/.

    <not_found>
      - Half-day leave option: NOT present in the codebase — leave uses full date ranges (startDate–endDate), no half-day flag or partial-day logic exists anywhere

  <!-- ARCHITECTURE SUMMARY FOR PLANNING -->
  <!--
  FRAMEWORK/STACK:
  - Electron 33 desktop app (electron/main.js)
  - Express 4 HTTP server (app.js → createApp())
  - Supabase Postgres backend (DATA_BACKEND=supabase)
  - Better-sqlite3 for local SQLite cache (lib/data-store.js)
  - Vanilla JS frontend, no React/Vue/Angular (public/js/app.js is the SPA router)
  - Session auth: express-session + custom session-store.js

  ROUTE STRUCTURE:
  /api/* → routes/api.js (main: employees, attendance, payroll, bonuses, deductions, loans, it-requests, meeting-requests, quality-notes, RBAC, org/managers)
  /api/hrms/* → routes/hrms.js (HRMS: org-structure, teams, employment-periods, training, leave, holidays, payroll-lock, equipment, notifications)
  /api/bonus-requests/* → routes/bonus-requests.js
  /api/loan-requests/* → routes/loan-requests.js
  /api/sales/* → routes/sales.js
  /api/expenses/* → routes/expenses.js
  /api/supabase/* → routes/supabase.js

  LEAVE/TIME-OFF:
  - Table: leave_requests (id, employee_id, start_date, end_date, leave_type, status, approved_by, notes, created_by)
  - Extended fields added in migrations: request_kind, paid_leave, late_submission, requested_by, requested_by_role
  - Kinds: annual (paid, 180+ days employment), unpaid, medical, same_day
  - NO half-day flag exists anywhere — needs new DB column + UI
  - Approval: hardcoded approvers: mark, raymond, phoebe (LEAVE_APPROVERS in lib/roles.js)
  - When approved: leaveAttendanceRecords() writes Day-OFF status to attendance_events

  IT TICKETS:
  - Table: it_requests + it_request_scope (v1.28 migration)
  - Fields: employee_id, title, description, category (hardware/software/network/account/equipment/other), urgency (low/normal/high/critical), status (open/in_progress/resolved/closed), assigned_to, resolution_notes, notes_hidden_from_requester
  - Routing: currently manual assignment only — no auto-routing rules exist
  - Permissions: canViewItRequests (IT/Admin/CEO + any with employeeId), canSubmitItRequest (any with employeeId), canAssignItRequest (IT/Admin/CEO/RTM), canResolveItRequest (IT/Admin/CEO)

  QUALITY TICKETS:
  - Two separate systems:
    1. employee_quality_notes (lib/quality-notes-repo.js): notes on agents (separate from HR warnings)
    2. Sales quality tickets: on sales records via routes/sales.js (not read in detail)
  - Quality notes fields: employee_id, author_username, author_role, body, note_date
  - Permissions: canViewQualityNotes (HR/Admin/CEO/Quality/RTM/TL/OP), canWriteQualityNotes (Quality/TL/OP/HR/Admin/CEO/RTM), canManageQualityNote (HR/Admin/CEO can edit all; quality can edit own)

  MEETING REQUESTS:
  - Table: meeting_requests (title, description, proposed_date, proposed_time, duration_minutes, requester_employee_id, requester_role, participants jsonb, status [pending/approved/rejected/rescheduled], reviewed_by, review_notes, rescheduled_proposal)
  - Participants: array of employee IDs or "team:unit|team" scope strings
  - Permissions: canSubmitMeetingRequest (any with employeeId), canViewMeetingRequests (Admin/CEO/HR + any with employeeId), canReviewMeetingRequest (Admin/CEO/HR only)
  - No calendar integration, no recurring meetings, no conflict detection

  COMPANY/UNIT ARCHITECTURE:
  - Two companies: "hangup" (HS-1, HS-3, HS-Back-End, HS-MGMT) and "hs2" (HS-2, HS2-PT)
  - Separation: lib/company-context.js — filterEmployeesByCompany(), isInHs2Scope(), isHs2Unit()
  - Role gates: canManageHs2Company (admin/ceo/hr), canSeeHs2InSales (admin/ceo/hr/quality)
  - Org managers: org_unit_managers table (unit, op_employee_id, hr_manager_id, quality_manager_id)
  - Multiple TLs per team: team_tls join table (v1.28)
  - Multiple OPs per unit: unit_ops join table (v1.28)
  - UNIT_RULES in lib/org-hierarchy.js: HS-1/HS-2/HS-3 have ops; Back-End/MGMT report to CEO
  - Position rates now have company column (v1.28) for HS2/Hangup separation

  NOTIFICATIONS:
  - Table: app_notifications (id, username, type, title, body, entity_type, entity_id, read_at, created_at)
  - Routing config table: notification_routing_rules (action_key PK, label, description, recipient_roles[], recipient_usernames[], enabled)
  - lib/notify-routing.js: audit-trail notifications (raymond gets unusual edits; mark is excluded)
  - lib/notify-dispatch.js: dispatches to recipients resolved from routing config
  - lib/notification-routing-config.js: 6 DEFAULT_RULES (leave_submitted, sale_agent_submitted, sale_pending, bonus_request_submitted, employee_note_created, quality_note_created)
  - IT/meeting routing rules seeded in v1.28 migration
  - Bell UI: public/js/hrms-features.js initNotificationsBell() — polls /hrms/notifications every 30s

  RBAC:
  - Roles (13): none, agent, office_assistant, quality, rtm, public_relations, tl, op, finance, it, hr, admin, ceo
  - DB tables: app_role_permissions (role, permission_key, allowed), app_user_permissions (username, permission_key, allowed)
  - Catalog: 68 permissions in lib/permission-catalog.js
  - Resolution: user override → role override → catalog default
  - Admin UI: Access Control page (admin/ceo only)
  - Username-based gates (NOT in RBAC): leave approvers, loan approvers, impersonation, session management (hardcoded to: mark, raymond, phoebe)

  FINANCE:
  - Loans: employee_loans table + loan_requests approval workflow (exec-only: mark/raymond/phoebe)
  - Bonuses: bonus_events table, bonus_requests approval workflow
  - Deductions: deduction_events table
  - TL/OP bonus transfer: "Bonus from TL / OP" type — creates paired bonus+deduction
  - Payroll splits: payroll_splits table for deferring/splitting salary payments
  - Payroll month lock: payroll_month_locks table — blocks edits when locked
  - Tax rules: stored in app_config (incomeTaxRate, socialInsuranceRate)
  -->
</result>
